lines.text: Jonah became angry and prayed that he fled toward Tarshish because God relents, then asked to die.
The LORD asked Jonah if he had any right to be angry, and Jonah sat down west of the city.
The LORD God appointed a vine to grow over Jonah's head, and Jonah was greatly pleased with it.
At dawn God appointed a locust that attacked the plant, and then the sun beat down so Jonah grew faint.
Jonah said he was angry enough to die, and the LORD asked if He should not care about Nineveh.
